$comment: keen-docs render-contract manifest. A doc_set selects a named render contract via settings.theme.id (global default: config :keen_docs, :theme); KeenDocs.Themes.render_block/1 merges the matching `keendocs` block below over the baseline defaults. This is keen-docs-NATIVE layout config (hero / breadcrumbs / TOC placement / region toggles / navbar composition) — NOT a CSS theme. keen-docs styles the pc-* app shell and its own kd-* components itself on @keenmate/pure-css (no pure-admin dependency, no theme stylesheet bundles).
